name: Wyvern
text: STRENGTH: 4 FLYING

name: Amphiptere
text: STRENGTH: 0 FLYING SCOUT

name: Lindwurm
text: STRENGTH: 0 Loses one battle without dying.
lore: The Lindwurm has seven skins making it hard to kill.

name: Guivre
text: STRENGTH: 2

name: Jormungandr
text: STRENGTH: 7
lore: The Jormungandr is a serpent that wraps himself around the world.

name: Tarasque
text: STRENGTH: 3
lore: Tarasque can only be killed by Holy Water.

name: Vittra
text: STRENGTH: 3 Flying dragons lose 2 strength for the rest of a battle that Vittra is part of.
lore: Vittra is a dragon of India that creates storms instead of fire.

name: Fafnir
text: STRENGTH: 2 Dwarven Armies cannot be used by either side in a battle that Fafnir is part of.
lore: This Germanic Dragon was once a Dwarf.  Upon dying his blood grants both knowledge and invulnerability.

name: Pakawjak
text: STRENGTH: 2 Fire Breathing cannot be used by either side in a battle that Pakawjak is part of.
lore: Pakawjak is an Arctic Dragon that breathes frost rather than fire.

name: Moghur
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT If first card attacked is terrain, Moghur may then attack a second card one card away from the first card.
lore: Moghur is a Dragon that can kill with a look.

name: Tiamat
text: STRENGTH: 3 FLYING
lore: Tiamat is one of the few female dragons.

name: Colchis
text: STRENGTH: 1
lore: Colchis is the Dragon that guards the Golden Fleece.

name: Gryphon
text: STRENGTH: 1 FLYING

name: Leviathan
text: STRENGTH: 5
lore: Leviathan is one of the biggest dragons in the world.  He is a fire breathing sea serpent.

name: Basilisk
text: STRENGTH: 3 Kills himself and one other dragon in battle.  No battle action cards are played in a battle that Basilisk is part of, and there is no winner or loser.

name: Typhon
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT

name: Echidna
text: STRENGTH: 3 If Echidna wins a battle you may turn any face up dragon face down.
lore: Echidna dwells in the 'secret parts' of the earth underground.

name: Chimera
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT Chimera attacks at 1 strength from face down.

name: Azhi Dahaka
text: STRENGTH: 2 FLYING
lore: Azhi Dahaka breathes fire, poison and hypnotic gas.

name: Mushussu
text: STRENGTH: 1 2 strength when attacking from face down.  0 strength when attacking from face up.

name: Lung Wong
text: STRENGTH: 2 Lung Wong defends at 3 strength from face up and attacks at 1 strength from face up.

name: Kakutan
text: STRENGTH: 3 Kakutan defends at 4 strength from face down and attacks at 2 strength from face down.
lore: Instead of flying, Kakutan runs like the wind.

name: Scylla
text: STRENGTH: 4 Scylla defends at 5 strength from face down and attacks at 3 strength from face up.

name: Vouivre
text: STRENGTH: 2 Vouivre may get help from a dragon one card away in this battle.  Flyers may help Vouivre from anywhere in your battlefield.
lore: Vouivre has a red carbuncle for an eye which when removed leaves him blind.

name: Thuhan
text: STRENGTH: 1 Gains +1 strength with each won battle.

name: Amphisbena
text: STRENGTH: 6
lore: Amphisbena loves the cold weather climates.

name: Phrygian
text: STRENGTH: 3 Phrygian may get help from a dragon one card away in this battle.  Flyers may help Phrygian from anywhere in your battlefield.

name: Cynoprosopi
text: STRENGTH: 4 Cynoprosopi may get help from a dragon one card away in this battle.  Flyers may help Cynoprosopi from anywhere in your battlefield.
lore: Cynoprosopi lives in the Sahara Desert.

name: Draco
text: STRENGTH: 3 Once Draco attacks he must continue to attack during that same turn until he dies or discovers terrain.
lore: Draco has a tail that can kill with one swipe.

name: Shapeshifter
text: STRENGTH: 3 Shapeshifter takes on the base strength of one dragon attacking it or defending against it.

name: Moat
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -2 Does not affect flying dragons.

name: Vines
text: No battle action cards can be played in a battle this dragon is part of.  Vines affect flying dragons only.

name: Coral Reef
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Swamp
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Frozen Lake
text: Kills dragons of 4 or more strength.  Has no effect on any other dragons.
lore: Big Dragons are on thin ice.

name: Pit
text: Kills dragons of 3 or less strength.

name: Cliff
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -2

name: Crevice
text: No battle action cards can be played in a battle this dragon is part of.  The Crevice does not affect flying dragons.

name: Wall
text: Dragon cannot get any help from other dragons during attack and defense for the rest of the game.

name: Desert
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Cave
text: Dragon can only attack face down cards for the rest of the game.  If there are no face down cards to attack he attacks a face up card he could normally attack at -1 strength.

name: Clouds
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -2 This card affects flyers only.

name: Forest
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Swamp Hole
text: Kills dragons of 2 or less strength.

name: Tunnel
text: Dragon can only attack cards in a direct line across from the dragon's card.  If there are no cards there to attack he may attack any card he could normally attack at -1 strength.

name: Quicksand
text: Quicksand causes dragon to lose one strength immediately and one strength during each of dragon owner's draw phases.

name: River
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Ocean
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Lake
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1

name: Mansion in the Sky
text: All face up flying dragons in this row are in the Mansion in the Sky.  Non-flying dragons lose two strength for the rest of a battle with a dragon in the Mansion.

name: Golden Fleece
text: Dragons in this row gain +2 strength when attacking.

name: Golden Apples
text: Dragons in this row can't be killed by terrain.

name: Pearl
text: When a dragon in this row wins a battle, draw one card from your treasure horde draw pile.

name: Jewels
text: Dragons in this row gain +1 strength when defending.

name: Dragon Egg
text: Action: Pay 3 gold pieces to hatch the Dragon Egg.  It becomes a two strength dragon.  Replace a card in your battlefield with Egg.  Egg starts face up.

name: Sword
text: Dragons in this row gain +1 strength when attacking.

name: Gold
text: When a dragon in this row wins a battle you get a gold piece.

name: Princess Libya
text: St. George must rescue Princess Libya instead of removing any other treasure in your battlefield.

name: Oriental Princess
text: Whoever wins a battle gets two gold pieces until Princess is removed from play.

name: Maiden in Distress
text: Dragons in this row can't be killed by dragon slayers.  Any dragon slayer can remove Maiden in Distress from game.

name: Firebreathing
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +1

name: Flood
text: No Dwarven Armies allowed in this battle.

name: Hailstorm
text: All flying dragons lose two strength for the rest of this battle.

name: Tsunami
text: For every one of your dragons you turn face up during this action phase, draw one card from your treasure horde draw pile.  Be sure to pay for any dragons being turned up for the first time.

name: High Winds
text: All face up flying dragons are killed.

name: Help
text: You may bring one dragon one card away into this battle.  Flying dragons can come from anywhere in your battlefield.

name: Frost Breathing
text: No Fire Breathing can be played during this battle.

name: Hero
text: One of your dragons can attack twice during your battle phase this turn.

name: Poison Breathing
text: The dragon that wins this battle loses 1 strength.  This takes effect after battle for rest of game.

name: Sacrifice
text: The winner of this battle must pay two gold pieces to the loser.

name: Knowledge
text: Look at a player's hand.

name: Magical Sword
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +2

name: Seaweed
text: Seaweed is played on a face up dragon and gives that dragon a -1 strength modifer for this turn.

name: Whirlpool
text: Draw 2 cards from your treasure horde draw pile.

name: Medea's Spell
text: A dragon of your choice is now 0 base strength for the rest of this battle.
lore: Medea is able to put dragons to sleep with her spell.

name: Fireball
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +4

name: Fire Bolt
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +3

name: Poison Chalice
text: The side with the lowest strength wins this battle.

name: Strangle Hold
text: Player of your choice must discard 2 cards from his hand.

name: Avalanche
text: All face up dragons are turned face down.

name: Earthquake
text: All players must discard 1 card from their hands.

name: Golden Apple
text: The dragon you play the Golden Apple on survives this battle even if he loses.

name: Armor
text: Counters any battle action card with the words STRENGTH MODIFIER on the card.

name: Night
text: Cancels current battle.  Dragons go back to their positions face up.

name: St. George
text: St. George removes any one treasure from the game.

name: Sigurd
text: Sigurd kills any dragon of 2 or less strength.

name: Sir Lancelot
text: Sir Lancelot kills any dragon of 3 or less strength.

name: Kiss of Le Succube
text: Kiss of Le Succube is played in response to the play of a dragon slayer.  The dragon slayer is discarded with no effect and you can destroy any card on the table.

name: Marina
text: Marina counters the play of a dragon slayer.
lore: The Russian Sorceress Marina likes to seduce brave dragon slayers and change them into harmless magpies, pigs or oxen.

name: Jason
text: Jason kills any dragon.

name: Shan
text: STRENGTH: 1 FLYING If Shan Dragon loses a battle you draw one card from your treasure horde draw pile.
lore: The Shan Dragon breathes mist and illusions.

name: Gani
text: STRENGTH: 3 If Gani is face up no treasure can be removed from this row by opponent.
lore: Gani is a Persian Dragon that guards treasure.

name: Hydra
text: STRENGTH: 4 After each battle the Hydra loses 1 strength.  You may pay one gold piece to grow another head and increase the Hydra's strength by one.  You may do this once a turn.

name: Grendel
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT Grendel steals any gold on terrain discovered by Grendel.

name: Celestial
text: STRENGTH: 5 FLYING
lore: The Celestrial Dragon is the Dragon of Emperors and rules all Chinese Dragons.

name: Mokelembembe
text: STRENGTH: 2 If Mokelembembe loses a battle you draw a card from your treasure horde draw pile.
lore: Mokelembembe is a vegetarian dragon that lives in a river cave.

name: Naga
text: STRENGTH: 3 Naga attacks at 6 strength from face down and 0 strength from face up.
lore: Naga is a serpent of India that can appear with a human head.

name: Gargouille
text: STRENGTH: 2 Pay one gold piece to increase strength by two for this battle.  You can only do this once per battle.
lore: Gargouille is a French Dragon that produces and controls Gargoyles.

name: Rahah
text: STRENGTH: 1 Rahah attacks at 2 strength from face down and 0 strength from face up.
lore: Rahah is a Biblical Dragon that can only be destroyed by White magic.

name: Kioh-lung
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT If Kioh-lung loses a battle, draw one card from your treasure horde draw pile.

name: Kulkulcan
text: STRENGTH: 3 SUPER FLYER Kulkulcan can attack any card.

name: Lambton Worm
text: STRENGTH: 1 Pay one gold to bring Lambton Worm from your dragon lair discard pile to a vacant position in your battlefield face down.  You can only do this once.
lore: Lambton Worm is a serpent that can regenerate.

name: Gandarewa
text: STRENGTH: 3 Gandarewa attacks at 4 strength from face down and 0 strength from face up.
lore: Gandarewa is a sea Dragon that is master of the water and its creatures.

name: Ajatar
text: STRENGTH: 4 Ajatar attacks at 8 strength from face down and 0 strength from face up.
lore: Ajatar can cause disease and curses.

name: Pan Lung
text: STRENGTH: 0 FLYING SCOUT Flying dragons lose one strength after any battle with Pan Lung.
lore: Pan Lung is a cloud Dragon that can cause storms and create fiery water.

name: Mountains
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -2

name: Snowdrifts
text: A dragon caught in a Snowdrift must pay one gold piece to attack.

name: Forest Fire
text: Kills any dragon that discovers it.  Replace Forest Fire then give it to opponent who can now destroy any card in play.

name: Brush Fire
text: This dragon can't use the effects of any treasure for the rest of the game.

name: Underwater Cave
text: Dragon can only attack face up cards for the rest of the game.  If there are no face up cards he then attacks a face down card at -1 strength.

name: Cauldron
text: Action: On each of your turns you may turn a dragon in this row face down.

name: Fountain of Youth
text: Battle Action: One dragon in this row can survive a lost battle.  As soon as  this happens you discard the Fountain of Youth.

name: Silver Chalice
text: Battle Action: A dragon in this row gains +1 Strength when attacking for each gold piece paid.

name: Magic Potion
text: Battle Action: One dragon in this row can help any other dragon in this row in a battle.

name: Magic Wand
text: Action: Any dragon in this row can become a flyer or a non-flyer for the rest of the turn.

name: Pick a Treasure
text: Action: Discard this treasure from your battlefield and put a treasure from your opponent's battlefield in its place.  Be sure to return the treasure to its owner after game.

name: Shipwreck
text: All terrain in this row gets a -1 strength modifier in addition to any on the card.

name: Secret Treasure
text: Action: Draw one card from your treasure horde draw pile for each gold piece you pay.

name: Treasure Room
text: When any dragon in this row loses a battle you get a gold piece.

name: Magic Shield
text: Battle Action: A dragon in this row gains +1 Strength when defending for each gold piece paid.

name: Snow Storm
text: A player of your choice misses next turn.

name: Twister
text: All players may rearrange all cards in their battlefield.

name: Volcanic Eruption
text: Bring any card back from your treasure horde discard pile to your hand.

name: Meteor Shower
text: All players discard their hands and draw 5 cards from their treasure horde draw piles.

name: Heatwave
text: All dragons who are face up lose 1 strength for this turn.

name: Magical Healing
text: One dragon of your choice is healed back to full strength.

name: Power Switch
text: The two dragons who started this battle switch base strength numbers until the end of the battle.

name: Magnetic Field
text: The Magnetic Field can be played at any time to counter the play of any kind of action card.

name: Dwarven Army
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +1

name: Crystal Ball
text: You may look at the next 5 cards in any player's treasure horde draw pile.  You may then reshuffle the draw pile or rearrange the 5 cards in any order you wish.

name: Possession Spell
text: You may possess the base strength of any face up dragon in any battlefield and add it to a dragon in this battle.  The dragon possessed cannot be one that is currently in the battle.  The dragon possessed now has a base strength of 0 for the rest of this battle.

name: Beowulf
text: Beowulf kills any dragon of 0 or less strength.

name: Battle Chaos
text: All players may bring as many dragons as they want into this battle from anywhere in their battlefields.

name: Doomsday
text: All face up dragons are killed.  All players draw 2 cards from their treasure horde draw pile for each of their dragons killed and replace each dragon with cards placed face down from their dragon lair draw pile.

name: Turn the Tables
text: You must play Turn the Tables during your opponent's turn.  You decide which card of yours gets attacked this turn.  Opponent must attack if possible.

name: Wyvern Shadow
text: Play on face up Wyvern.  Adds +2 strength to Wyvern for rest of game.

name: Vampire
text: STRENGTH: 1 When Vampire is attacking one strength is taken away from each defending dragon and added to Vampire.  These strength changes are permanent.

name: Loki
text: STRENGTH: 2 Get one gold piece from the gold mine for each won battle.
lore: Loki is a Dragon from Icelandic legend.

name: Mo-o
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT Get one gold piece from the gold mine each time Mo-o discovers a terrain.
lore: Mo-o is one of many Hawaiian Dragons.

name: Geates
text: STRENGTH: 2 FLYING When Geates wins a battle, one treasure in row of losing dragon is discarded.  You decide which one.
lore: Geates is the Dragon slayed by Beowulf in Anglo-Saxon myth.

name: Dragonel
text: STRENGTH: 2 When Dragonel wins a battle you get one card from your treasure horde draw pile.
lore: Dragonel is a young Dragon.

name: Tatzlwurm
text: STRENGTH: 2 SUBTERRANEAN Giant Ants cannot be played by either side in a battle Tatzlwurm is part of.

name: Pi-Hsi
text: STRENGTH: 2 Pi-Hsi gains +2 strength in current battle if a treasure in this row is discarded.
lore: Pi-Hsi is Dragon Ruler of the Rivers.

name: Chen Lung
text: STRENGTH: 3 When Chen Lung is face up you cannot be forced to discard any cards from your hand.
lore: Chen-Lung is a Chinese guardian Dragon.

name: Ryu
text: STRENGTH: 3 FLYING Ryu gains one strength for each treasure played in this row when he is face up.  Ryu loses this strength if he is turned face down.

name: Bait
text: STRENGTH: 2 Archers cannot be used by either side in a battle that Bait is part of.
lore: Bait is a four-winged serpent from ancient Egyptian mythology.

name: Cecrops
text: STRENGTH: 2 FLYING No Ravens can be played by either side in a battle the Cecrops is part of.

name: Giant
text: STRENGTH: 5 Giant costs 4 gold pieces when turned face up and loses one strength in your draw phase each turn his is face up.  Giant goes back to  5 strength if he is turned face down.
lore: Giant is a serpent-footed Dragon of Roman mythology.

name: Abraxus
text: STRENGTH: 0 You may discard Abraxus from your battlefield during a battle to give any other Dragon +3.  If Abraxus is face down when you do this, then pay the 1 gold cost.
lore: Abraxus is the ruler of magical influence.

name: Ea
text: STRENGTH: 0 Pay gold in battle to raise Ea's strength by one for each gold piece paid.

name: Osiris
text: STRENGTH: 4 SUBTERRANEAN
lore: Osiris is a Leviathan of the Deep.

name: Kane-kua-ana
text: STRENGTH: 1 You may discard Kane-kua-ana from your battlefield instead of a dragon that just lost a battle.  If Kane-kua-ana is face down when this happens then pay the 2 gold cost.
lore: Kane-kua-ana is the Hawaiian Dragon that brought the oysters to Ewa Lagoon.

name: Apep
text: STRENGTH: 3 SUBTERRANEAN
lore: Apep is an Egyptian Dragon that symbolizes darkness and evil.

name: Indra
text: STRENGTH: 2 FLYING Indra can help any dragon in a battle.
lore: Indra is an Indian Dragon known as the Drought Dragon.

name: Yellow
text: STRENGTH: 4 Immune to dragon slayers.  You get one gold from gold mine each of your draw phases Yellow Dragon is face up.
lore: Chinese Dragon that rules over the last month of summer.

name: Bride's Serpent
text: STRENGTH: 3 When Bride's Serpent wins a battle loser must discard one card from hand at random.
lore: The Bride's Serpent is a Scottish Dragon.

name: Blue
text: STRENGTH: 5 SUPER FLYER Immune to dragon slayers.  Can attack any card.  Draw an extra card in each of your draw phases that Blue is face up.
lore: Chinese Dragon that rules spring.

name: White
text: STRENGTH: 4 FLYING Immune to dragon slayers.  When White is face up opponent can't play treasure cards.
lore: Chinese Dragon that rules autumn.

name: Black
text: STRENGTH: 4 SUBTERRANEAN Immune to dragon slayers.  Opponent loses one gold to the gold mine on each of his draw phases that Black is face up.
lore: Chinese Dragon that rules winter.

name: Red
text: STRENGTH: 6 Immune to dragon slayers.  Add +1 to all battle action strength modifiers when played on Red.
lore: Chinese Dragon that rules over summer.

name: Mount Chung
text: STRENGTH: 3 Pay two gold pieces to cancel any battle that Mount Chung is part of.
lore: When the Mount Chung Dragon opens its eyes it's day and when he closes them it's night.

name: Ananta
text: STRENGTH: 3 Subterranean dragons lose two strength for rest of battle that Ananta is part of.
lore: Ananta is an Indian serpent with nine heads.

name: Delphyne
text: STRENGTH: 0 FLYING SCOUT Get one card from your treasure horde draw pile each time Delphyne discovers a terrain.
lore: Delphyne is a she-Dragon from Greek mythology.

name: Python
text: STRENGTH: 2 SUBTERRANEAN

name: Nidhoggr
text: STRENGTH: 1 SUBTERRANEAN
lore: Nidhoggr is the first Nordic Dragon.  He is known for gnawing at the root of the Universal Tree.

name: Laidly Worm
text: STRENGTH: 1 When Laidly Worm loses a battle the winning player must discard one card at random from his hand.
lore: The Laidly Worm used to be a beautiful girl who was turned into a Dragon.

name: Sito
text: STRENGTH: 4 When Sito wins a battle you get one gold piece from the gold mine.
lore: Sito is the Devine Serpent of Egypt.

name: Lotan
text: STRENGTH: 3 No battle action cards can be used by either side in battle with Lotan.
lore: Lotan is a Primeval Serpent with seven heads from Cananite mythology.

name: Midgard Serpent
text: STRENGTH: 0 SCOUT SUBTERRANEAN
lore: The Nordic Serpent of Midgard.

name: Behomoth
text: STRENGTH: 7 FLYING
lore: Behomoth with fight Leviathan at the end of the world.

name: Aaron's Rod
text: Battle Action: A dragon in this row gains +1 Strength for each card you discard from your hand.
lore: When Aaron cast t he rod before the Pharoah it became a serpent.

name: Dragon Mother
text: When Dragon Mother is in play the top card of all treasure horde draw piles is always face up.
lore: The Dragon Mother can tell future events.

name: Dragon Bones
text: Action: Pay one gold piece to remove as many cards as you want from one dragon in this row.
lore: Dragon Bones are used for medicinal purposes.

name: Dragon Skin
text: When replacing any card in your battlefield draw two cards from your dragon lair draw pile.  Discard the card you don't use.
lore: Dragon Skin glows in the dark.

name: Tablets of Destiny
text: During each of your draw phases you may pay one gold piece and call out a card.  Opponent must discard one of that card if he has it.
lore: The Tablets of Destiny were discovered by the Babylonian Marduk.

name: Dragon Ashes
text: During each of your draw phases you may pay one gold piece and discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's treasure horde draw pile.

name: Dracontias
text: Dragons in this row cost one less gold when turned face up.
lore: Dracontias is a gem found in the head of a Dragon.  It must be removed while the Dragon is living to be valuable.

name: Vishnu
text: A face up dragon of your choice must be turned face down.  This dragon will have to be paid for again the next time it is turned face up.

name: Indra's Spell
text: Counters any weather related action card (Heatwave, High Winds, Flood, etc.) Can be used during a battle.
lore: Indra is the Indian Weather God who can abruptly change the weather.

name: Apollo
text: Draw 2 cards from your treasure horde draw pile.

name: Cadmus
text: Cadmus kills any flying dragon.
lore: Cadmus is a Greek Dragon Slayer.

name: Thor
text: Thor kills any subterranean dragon.

name: Poisonous Air
text: All players lose one gold piece for each face up dragon in their battlefields.

name: Pirendeus Tree
text: The card you play the Pirendeus Tree on cannot be attacked by a dragon this turn.
lore: Dragons always avoid the Pirendeus Tree.

name: Martha of Bethany
text: Play on a face up dragon.  This dragon is immune to dragon slayers for as long as Martha is on the dragon.  If this dragon turns face down, Martha is discarded.
lore: Dragon Slayerrs have to eat too.

name: Marduk
text: No battle action cards can be played this turn.
lore: Marduk is the son of Tiamat.

name: Ra
text: This battle cannot be canceled.
lore: Ra is the Sun God.

name: Seth
text: Seth attacks an opponent's face down card.  Turn the attacked card face up.  If it's a terrain card it is discarded.  If it's a dragon it stays face up and is not paid for.

name: Zeus
text: No scouts can attack this turn.

name: Hercules
text: Play on a face up dragon that is immune to dragon slayers.  The dragon is no longer immune to dragon slayers as long as Hercules is on the dragon.  Discard Hercules if dragon is turned face down.

name: Pitch
text: The dragon that Pitch is played on loses 2 strength for each fire battle action card played on him instead of gaining strength from the fire cards.  (Ex: Firebreathing, Fireball, etc.)
lore: Pitch is very flammable and will explode when fire gets near it.

name: Sabra
text: Sabra is played in response to the play of St. George.  You get two gold from the gold mine and you get to remove any treasure in play.
lore: Sabra is a princess who married St. George.

name: King Arthur
text: Any dragon slayer played this turn cannot be countered with a reaction card.

name: Illuyankus
text: STRENGTH: 3 FLYING When Illuyankus is one of the two dragons starting a battle no help is allowed by either side.
lore: Illuyankus is a Dragon from Hittite mythology.

name: Valley
text: Play this on a face up dragon.  This dragon cannot get or give help for this turn.

name: Stream
text: Dragon's owner must pay one gold piece to the gold mine each of his draw phases that the Stream is on the dragon.

name: Gully
text: No help is allowed by either side in any battle this turn.

name: Castle
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +3 You can only play the Castle when you are defending in a battle.

name: City
text: A dragon of your choice can be turned face down.

name: Village
text: Remove any one card from a dragon.

name: Town
text: You may replace two dragon or terrain cards in your battlefield this turn and still do a dragon slayer action or a battle phase.

name: Abbey
text: This dragon cannot survive a lost battle no matter what cards are played, are in play, or what it says on the dragon.

name: Trap
text: This dragon now belongs to you.  It stays on the Trap in your battlefield.  Pay two gold each of your draw phases to keep dragon.  If trap is removed, or you don't pay, dragon goes back to original owner's battlefield and Trap is discarded.

name: Hurricane
text: Kills any flying dragon.

name: Island
text: Any flying dragon now belongs to you.  Dragon stays on island in your battlefield.  If Island is removed dragon goes back to original owner's battlefield.

name: Ruins
text: If this dragon is turned face down it must be paid for again when it is turned face up.

name: Subterranean River
text: This dragon is now a subterranean dragon and can attack any card as long as the Subterranean River is on him.  Subterranean River is discarded if dragon is turned face down.

name: Subterranean Gold Mine
text: All your subterranean dragons gain +1 Strength when attacking.

name: Subterranean Lair
text: Any subterranean dragon is now yours.  The dragon stays on the subterranean lair in your battlefield.  If Lair is removed dragon returns to original owner's battlefield.

name: City in the Sky
text: All your flying dragons gain +1 strength when attacking.

name: Subterranean Tunnels
text: All your subterranean dragons can now attack any card in the battlefield.

name: Dwarven Gold Mine
text: Place this card next to an existing treasure position.  This makes a new position for treasure.  You may play any treasure on the Dwarven Gold Mine.  If the Dwarven Gold Mine is removed so is any treasure on it.

name: Dragon Man
text: If two dragons of the same name are face up on the battlefield, you decide which one is immediately replaced from the player's dragon lair draw pile.

name: Great Library of Ninevah
text: You cannot be forced to discard any cards from your hand.

name: Hall of Chivalry
text: Put Hall of Chivalry on a face up dragon.  This dragon must attack this turn.  If the dragon can't legally attack then it must be replaced.  Play during opponent's turn.

name: Windsock Banner
text: All your Archers gain +1 and cannot be stopped by any battle action or reaction cards.

name: Sea Goat
text: STRENGTH: 4 Gain two gold pieces from the Gold Mine each time an opponent plays a Reaction card.

name: Drachenfels
text: STRENGTH: 4 FLYING Native Terrain: Mountain.  Battle Action: Pay one gold piece; opposing Dragon gets a -1 strength counter.  This may be done once per battle.

name: Helix
text: STRENGTH: 1 Native Terrain: Vines.  Action: Pay one gold; no Battle Action Cards may be played this turn.

name: Ripplet
text: STRENGTH: 3 Native Terrain: Stream.  When Ripplet loses a battle opponent must pay you two gold.  If opponent cannot pay they must discard a card from  their hand at random.

name: Lacustrian
text: STRENGTH: 2 Native Terrain: Lake x2

name: Teuton
text: STRENGTH: 1 Native Terrain: Forest

name: Kalahari
text: STRENGTH: 4 Native Terrain: Desert.  Heatwaves have no effect on Kalahari.  Each Heatwave in your discard pile counts as if it were a Desert Terrain.

name: Riparian
text: STRENGTH: 3 FLYING Native Terrain: River.  Action: Pay one gold piece to look at opponent's hand; opponent must discard all Dwarven Armies.

name: Miasma
text: STRENGTH: 0 Native Terrain: Swamp x2

name: Bellerophon
text: Bellerophon kills any Dragon with the Native Terrain special ability, or allows you to remove from the game up to three cards from your opponent's discard piles.

name: Argonauts
text: The Argonauts kill every face up Dragon whose current strength is less than zero.

name: Rustem
text: Opponent must discard an Intercept Action from their hand.  If they have no Intercept Actions you still must skip your Battle Phase.

name: Reclaimed Treasure
text: Return any Treasure card from your Treasure Horde Discard Pile to your hand.

name: Sanctuary
text: Target face up Dragon can't be attacked by a Dragon unless your opponent pays three gold pieces to the Gold Mine.  In each of your Draw Phases, pay two gold pieces to the Gold Mine or discard Sanctuary from target Dragon.

name: All or Nothing
text: Roll a six-sided die.  On a result of 1 through 5, you gain gold equal to double the number rolled.  On a result of 6, you lose all of your positions and the game.  Score the game normally.

name: Torrential Rains
text: You may rearrange all the cards in an opponent's battlefield; no cards may be turned face up or face down, and attached cards may not change targets.  You may not look at face down cards.

name: Lost City
text: Opponent may not look at any face down cards in their battlefield during the remainder of this turn and the next.

name: Golem
text: Replace any Dragon or face down Terrain in your battlefield with the Golem, which instantly becomes a duplicate of any face up Dragon in play for the rest of the  game.  If original Dragon leaves play, Golem is discarded and not replace.

name: Grave Diggers
text: Return any Dragon Slayer card from your Treasure Horde Discard Pile to your hand.

name: Stolen Equipment
text: Each player selects and discards one card from their hand for each face up Dragon in their battlefield.

name: Freya
text: Immediately exchange any Dragon or face down Terrain in your battlefield with the top card of your Dragon Lair Draw Pile.

name: Treasure Find
text: Search your Treasure Horde Draw Pile for any Treasure and put it directly into play, paying for it normally.

name: Gold Dig
text: You gain X gold pieces; X equals the number of gold symbols on the top card in your Dragon Lair Discard Pile.

name: Brain Drain
text: Target Dragon loses all special abilities while Brain Drain is on it.  Discard Brain Drain if target Dragon is turned face down.

name: Windfall
text: Each player gains one gold piece from the Gold Mine for each face up Dragon in his or her battlefield when Windfall is played.

name: Shifting Sands
text: You may rearrange all the cards in your battlefield.  No cards may be t urned face up or face down and attached cards may not change targets.

name: Treasure Fire
text: All of your opponents' Treasures that are in play when you play Treasure Fire are immediately discarded.

name: Thunderbolt
text: For each gold you pay in addition to the cost of Thunderbolt, put a -1 strength counter on any one face up Dragon.

name: Black Rainbow
text: Turn all of your own face up Dragons face down.

name: Rainbow
text: Turn as many of your Dragons as you wish face up (paying for them, if required).  Gain one gold piece from the Gold Mine for each Dragon turned face up by this Action.

name: Scorpion Men
text: The player who wins this battle must discard the top two cards from his or her Dragon Lair Draw Pile.

name: Alberich
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +1 The winner of this battle gains one additional Treasure Position in this row.  Use Alberich to mark the new position.  Alberich counts as a Dwarven Army.

name: Horn of the Unicorn
text: You may discard any Dragon in your Battlefield instead of the Dragon that loses this battle.  You may not discard a Dragon that was involved in the Battle.  Discarded Dragon need not have been paid for.

name: Mental Domination
text: You can force any face up Dragon of two or less base strength to Help on either side of this battle.  Target Dragon can't already be in the battle.

name: Spectral Shift
text: Exchange one of your Dragons in this battle with the top card of your Dragon Lair Draw Pile.  If you draw a Terrain, discard it and draw again.  If it is a Dragon you must pay for it normally.

name: Flag of Truce
text: Pay two gold pieces to your opponent; all of your Dragons survive this battle.

name: Deep Freeze
text: At the end of the battle, the winning Dragon's base strength becomes zero (and remains zero) as long as Deep Freeze is on it.  Dragon's owner may discard three cards from their hand (as an Action) to remove Deep Freeze.

name: Royal Archers
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +2 Playable only by the defending player, not on a flying or subterranean Dragon.  If target Dragon survives this battle, put a +1 or -1 strength counter on any face up Dragon.

name: Possession From Beyond
text: Add the base strength of any Dragon that is the top card of any Dragon Lair Discard Pile to your side in this battle.  The possessed Dragon's base strength becomes zero for the rest of this battle.

name: Nibelungs
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +1 The player that wins this battle may draw two additional cards in his or her next Draw Phase.  The Nibelungs counts as a Dwarven Army.

name: Tower of Babel
text: Each Dragon helping in this battle counts as a -2 strength modifier for its side, instead of adding its strength to the battle.

name: Dwarven Legion
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +2 The player that wins this battle gains gold each to the strength difference between the two sides at the end of the battle.  Dwarven Legion counts as a Dwarven Army.

name: Thor's Hammer
text: Target Dragon's Base Strength is doubled for the rest of this battle.  No more than one Thor's Hammer may be played on each Dragon.

name: Last Will and Testament
text: If target Dragon is killed in this battle its owner gains gold equal to the target Dragon's base strength plus gold symbols.

name: Lucky Strike
text: Whoever is behind in this battle when Lucky Strike is played gains one gold piece from the Gold Mine.

name: Sorcerer
text: The Sorcerer duplicates any Action or Reaction card just played by your opponent.  The Sorcerer is also playable as a Battle Reaction to duplicate any Battle Action just played by your opponent.

name: Field of Gold
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: +1

name: Arctic Winds
text: Dragon with Arctic Winds on it may not move during its owner's Movement Phase.

name: Poison Forest
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -3

name: Swamp of Lernea
text: A Dragon in the Swamp of Lernea may be killed by any Dragon Slayer, regardless of what the Dragon Slayer card says.

name: Overgrown Monument
text: Draw a card from your Treasure Horde if Overgrown Monument applies to the Dragon that discovers it.  Counts as both Ruins and Vines for Native Terrain Dragons.

name: Waterfall
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Counts as both a Stream and a Mountain for Native Terrain Dragons.

name: Oasis
text: Counts as both a Desert and a Lake for Native Terrain Dragons.

name: Delta
text: If Delta applies to the Dragon that discovers it the Dragon's owner must discard a card at random from their hand.  Counts as both a River and an Ocean for Native Terrain Dragons.

name: Chaparral
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Chameleon Reaction: Pay three gold pieces to change Chaparral to a Strength 0 Dragon for the rest of the game.  While attacking, Chaparral has an Assigned Strength equal to the number of Terrain cards in your Discard Pile.

name: Bracken
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Chameleon Reaction: Pay one gold piece to change Bracken to a Strength 0 Subterranean Scout for the rest of the game.

name: Shoal
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Chameleon Reaction: Pay five gold pieces to change Shoal to a Strength 4 Subterranean Dragon for the rest of the game.

name: Grotto
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Chameleon Reaction: Pay four gold pieces to change Grotto to a Strength 3 Subterranean Dragon for the rest of the game.

name: Crag
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Chameleon Reaction: Pay three gold pieces to change Crag to a Strength 2 Subterranean Dragon for the rest of the game.

name: Nebula
text: STRENGTH MODIFIER: -1 Chameleon Reaction: Pay two gold pieces to change Nebula to a Strength 1 Flying Dragon for the rest of the game.

name: Gold Market
text: When you play the Gold Market, put two of your gold pieces on it.  In each of your Draw Phase place one gold piece from the Gold Mine on it.  Action: Discard Gold Market and put all t he gold on it into your gold pile.

name: Gold Vault
text: Action: Transfer any number of gold pieces between your Gold Pile and the Gold Vault.  Gold in the Vault may not be spent for any reason and may not be lost or stolen.  If the Vault changes owners or leaves play, all gold in the Vault goes with it.

name: Master Ring
text: If the Master Ring is in the same row with a Dwarven Gold Mine, the Dwarven Gold Mine now provides unlimited Treasure positions in its row.  If Master Ring is removed or stolen all excess Treasures are discarded.

name: Ring of Power
text: All of your Dwarven Army Battle Actions gain +1 Strength and can't be cancelled or countered.
lore: The ring Draupnir, crafted by the Nibelungs, was worn by Odin.

name: Ring of Destiny
text: Action: In opponent's first Action Phase, you decide which opposing face up Dragon attacks and which of your cards will be attacked.  Opponent then places Ring of Destiny in one of their Treasure positions.  Discard Ring after its second use.

name: Heavyweight Alliance
text: Battle Action: All of your Dragons of four or more base strength may Help each other.

name: Rebate
text: Whenever any card played is countered, the gold paid to play it is refunded.

name: Precious Gems
text: Each Dragon in this row gains +2 strength while defending (including against Dragon Slayers).

name: Cracked Cauldron
text: Action: Turn one Dragon in this row face up (paying for it, if required).  This Action may be used once on each of your turns.

name: Enchanted Mirror
text: If your opponent plays a card that allows them to get a card back from a discard pile, or allows them to draw additional cards from their Treasure Horde, you may perform the same action for free.  This does not include cards that affect all players.

name: Spoils of War
text: Each time an opponent loses a Battle position, draw one card from your Treasure Horde Draw Pile.

name: Serpent Lance
text: Action: Place a -1 strength counter on any face up Dragon, then flip a Wyvern Gold Coin.  Heads: Place another -1 counter on the target Dragon.  Tails: Discard Serpent Lance.  You may continue flipping until tails results.

name: Runic Tablet
text: Action: The next game activity you perform that requires payment is free.  Runic Tablet is then given to your opponent who places it in any open Treasure position.  Runic Tablet gets discarded after its second use.

name: Hidden Gold
text: On each of your Draw Phases that you begin with no gold in your gold pile, gain one gold piece from the Gold Mine.

name: Flying Boulder
text: Action: Discard Flying Boulder and place three -1 strength counters on any one face up Dragon.
